summary: Atari Games' post-apocalyptic top-down vehicular-combat racer, a weaponized successor to the Sprint-style arcade racing format.

entries.title: Badlands

emulation.notes: MAME or original hardware is the primary route; console and Windows compilations provide official access to the arcade game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Badlands originated as an Atari Games arcade release and later received lower-fidelity home-computer ports plus official emulated compilation releases. The original arcade version is the highest-fidelity baseline and the source version for the later compilations.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; Midway Arcade Treasures 3 on PlayStation 2, GameCube, or Xbox is an official emulated fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: Midway Arcade Treasures 3 and Deluxe Edition are official compilation/emulation routes rather than remasters.
